topic: Quotient positivity for complete pseudo-Pick pairs of reproducing kernels
title: A three-point negative answer to Luo–McCullough–Tsikalas's pseudo-Pick quotient question

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We answer Question 9.3 of Luo, McCullough and Tsikalas, Beurling Criteria for Reproducing Kernels, arXiv:2607.25088v2 (2026), page 45, negatively on a three-point set: a rank-two source kernel forces constant full interpolation data, while positive retraction quotients extend every proper datum at every matrix size. The source kernel is non-vanishing, the target kernel is strictly positive definite, and their entrywise quotient has quadratic form -10/33 at (-2,1,1). Three points and source rank two are minimal. A diagonal perturbation gives a one-parameter family with the same negative answer. The family is neither complete Pick, Beurling–Lax–Halmos, complete pseudo-Leech, nor weakly Agler-decomposable.
summary: On three points, the non-vanishing rank-two source k(i,j)=1+x_i*x_j, x=(1/10,1,2), and targets ell_t(i,j)=1+delta_ij*x_i^2+t*delta_ij*k(i,i), 0<=t<5/99, form complete pseudo-Pick pairs with positive definite targets and indefinite quotients. Their negative quadratic form is -10/33+6t. Written proofs establish the all-size interpolation, minimal cardinality and source rank, and failure of complete Pick, BLH, pseudo-Leech and weak/strong Agler decompositions. The pinned Lean declaration covers the t=0 quotient obstruction and all-size interpolation; the parameter family and other deductions have written proofs. Exact rational identities and a rational interior example are supplied.
